    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPrison canteen sandwichesCrisp butter griddled white bread with devon, cheese and mustard.How to make it8 slices of white bread20g yellow mustard120g devon80g American-style cheese slices30g butter, softenedSpread the bread with mustard and layer devon and cheese between the slices to make sandwiches.Butter the outsides.Griddle under a weighted pan until crisp and the cheese melts, turning once. Work in batches.Cut into fingers to share.LA street tacosChopped grilled steak tacos with onion, coriander and salsa verde.How to make it500g skirt steak4 limes2 garlic cloves1 tsp ground cumin12 small corn tortillas1 white onion1 small bunch coriander150g salsa verdeMarinate the steak in lime juice, crushed garlic and cumin.Grill hot on both sides.Rest the steak, then chop small.Warm the tortillas and dice the onion.Fill the tortillas with steak, onion, coriander and salsa verde, with lime wedges on the side.MainsTango's tailored rib eyeDry brined steak basted with butter, thyme and garlic.How to make it4 rib eye steaks (about 200g each)1 tsp fine salt1 tbsp neutral oil50g butter4 sprigs of thyme3 garlic clovesPat the steaks dry, season with salt and refrigerate uncovered to dry-brine.Heat a heavy pan with oil until hot and sear the steaks hard on both sides, in batches.Lower the heat, add the butter, thyme and crushed garlic and baste. Take out at 54°C in the centre for medium rare.Rest the steaks, slice and spoon over the pan butter.Breakout glazed meatloaf and mashThe slop before the zip line breakoutHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, thick slices on buttery mash with minted peas.Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and salt.Shape into a loaf in a lined tin.Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, spread over and bake at 180°C for 60 minutes.Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk.Cook 300g frozen peas 3 minutes and toss with butter and mint.Rest the loaf 10 minutes before slicing.SweetsKiki's cupcakesVanilla cupcakes with pink buttercream and a generous coat of sprinkles.How to make it80g butter, softened, for the cakes80g caster sugar1 egg1 tsp vanilla extract100g self-raising flour40ml milk, for the cakes60g butter, softened, for icing120g icing sugar1 tsp milk, for icing1/4 tsp pink food colouring20g sprinklesHeat the oven to 180°C with 8 cupcake cases in a tin. Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the egg and vanilla.Fold in the flour and milk, divide between the cases and bake.Cool the cupcakes completely.Beat the icing butter with the icing sugar and milk until fluffy and tint pink.Pipe onto the cupcakes and cover with sprinkles.DrinksTango's sharp-dressed ManhattanRye whiskey stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters until ice cold, strained into chilled coupes with a dark cocktail cherry.How to make it4 coupe glasses200ml rye whiskey80ml sweet vermouth8 dashes of aromatic bitters1 tray ice4 cocktail cherries1 orangeChill the coupes in the freezer.Stir the rye, vermouth and bitters over ice in a jug until very cold.Strain into the coupes and drop a cherry into each. Twist orange peel over the top.
